mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.0 and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by more than 2% over two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 1% for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by more than 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for at least three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.5% signals labor market tightening, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month increase in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals strengthening demand, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises by more than 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8% and a decline in payroll employment growth below 0.2% for two months signals severe labor market distress, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.0 and PAYEMS growth falls below 0.2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
